name: store-screenshots
description: Plan, write and design App Store / Google Play screenshots that explain the app and don't look AI-made - from the app's own visual DNA, three app-specific concepts and free compositions built from its real screens (never altered), exported as PNG + editable SVG for every store size; with a classified library of 1,700+ real top-chart screenshots (TR + US), category playbooks, and scripts for search, rendering, store checks and peer tests.
